statement: Power side of the 2012 250 SX-F and 350 SX-F. White/red is battery positive after the 10 A main fuse, which sits in the starter relay; it feeds the capacitor, the voltage regulator, the power relay and EFI pin 14. Orange is power switched by the power relay and feeds the EFI unit (pin 1), injector, FI warning lamp and diagnostics connector. White/black is the power relay control line: EFI pin 30, power relay, voltage regulator pin 1 and diagnostics pin 5. Brown is ground. Starter button: brown in, red/blue out to the starter relay. Voltage regulator plug: brown, white/red, white/black, with two single-wire plugs to the alternator. Kill switch: black/yellow from EFI pin 34, black to frame ground. Fuel pump: blue/gray and brown. Heavy black cables run battery to starter relay to starter motor and battery negative to ground. KTM's colour letters: bl black, br brown, bu blue, gn green, gr gray, lbu light blue, or orange, pu violet, rd red, wh white, ye yellow.
notes: Read from the wiring diagram by eye; check the diagram on the bike before cutting, splicing or back-probing.

Kill switch: white/gray from EFI pin 34, black to frame ground. Fuel pump (3-pin plug): blue/gray and brown. The map-select switch plugs into the launch control switch, which sits on black/brown from EFI pin 4 and black sensor ground. topic: Charging and power wiring (kick start, no battery)
statement: The 2011 250 SX-F is kick start with no battery, starter or power relay. The voltage regulator plug is brown (ground), white/red (power out) and white/black, with two single-wire plugs to the alternator. White/red feeds the capacitor and EFI pin 14, and becomes orange at a 4-pin plug to feed the EFI unit (pin 1), injector, FI warning lamp and diagnostics connector. White/black links the regulator, EFI pin 30 and diagnostics pin 5. Capacitor: white/red and brown. Kill switch: black/yellow from EFI pin 34, black to frame ground. Fuel pump: blue/gray and brown. KTM's colour letters: bl black, br brown, bu blue, gn green, gr gray, lbu light blue, or orange, pu violet, rd red, wh white, ye yellow.
notes: Read from the wiring diagram by eye; check the diagram on the bike before cutting, splicing or back-probing.

topic: Complete wiring: CDI, starter and charging (carbureted)
statement: The 2012 450 SX-F is carbureted with a CDI controller on an 18-pin plug. Pin 1 white/blue: ignition coil. Pin 2 brown: ground. Pin 3 white: voltage regulator pin 1. Pin 6 white/red: battery positive. Pin 9 black/yellow: kill switch, which grounds it. Pins 10 and 11, red and green: crankshaft position sensor. Pins 12, 13, 14, blue, yellow, black: throttle position sensor. Pin 7 black/gray and pin 5 gray: ignition curve connector (a single-pin plug pair; joined or separated selects the curve). Voltage regulator plug: white, white/black (to the starter relay) and white/brown (ground), with two single-wire plugs to the alternator. Starter relay with 10 A main fuse: white/red, white/black, and black to the starter button; the button's other wire is brown to ground. KTM's colour letters: bl black, br brown, bu blue, gn green, gr gray, lbu light blue, or orange, pu violet, rd red, wh white, ye yellow.
notes: Read from the wiring diagram by eye; check the diagram on the bike before cutting, splicing or back-probing. Which curve the joined and separated positions select is not shown on the diagram.
